title: DERIVED_VARIABLES — Family History
description: Cancer in first-degree relatives (parents, full siblings, children), by site, derived from the baseline questionnaire.

R0_FamHistCancer.title: Family history of any cancer in first-degree relatives (parents, full siblings, or children).
R0_FamHistCancer.x-derivation: Set to 1 if any first-degree relative (mother, father, full sibling, or child) has a cancer entry whose coded site equals contains indications of any cancer. Currently derived from legacy SAS scripts.
R0_FamHistCancer.$comment: Former name: famca. Source derivation text reads 'equals contains' [sic].

R0_FamHistCancerNum.title: Count of number of first-degree relatives with any cancer.
R0_FamHistCancerNum.x-derivation: Total count of first-degree relatives (mother, father, full sibling, or child) that have cancer entry whose coded site equals contains indications of any cancer. Currently derived from legacy SAS scripts.
R0_FamHistCancerNum.$comment: Former name: famcaN. Source derivation text reads 'equals contains' [sic].

$comment: Soft checks: for each site, the count (R0_FamHistCancerNum, R0_FamHistBCNum, R0_FamHistOVNum, R0_FamHistColoNum, R0_FamHistProstNum) should be at least 1 when its flag is 1 and 0 when its flag is 0 (D033).
